otp_summary: ONFI defines two factory-programmed (OTP-style) device identification structures plus a factory defect map. (1) Read ID (90h) returns the JEDEC manufacturer ID + device ID, factory-programmed. (2) Read Parameter Page (ECh) returns a 256-byte self-description (geometry, ECC requirements, supported timing modes, manufacturer/model ASCII), factory-programmed and stored in at least 3 redundant copies, CRC-protected (polynomial 8005h, initial 4F4Eh). (3) Read Unique ID (EDh) returns a 16-byte unique-per-device identifier with bit-wise complement repeated 16 times; combined with manufacturer ID it uniquely identifies a device. (4) Factory defect mapping (Section 3.3) — bad blocks are marked at the manufacturer's facility before shipment; first byte of the spare area of the first or last page of each bad block is non-FFh.

otp_registers.name: Parameter Page (Read Parameter Page ECh)
otp_factory_fields: Number of data bytes per page (bytes 80-83)
Number of spare bytes per page (bytes 84-85)
tPROG / tBERS / tR / tCCS / tADL timing parameters
Supported SDR / NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 timing modes

fields.name: UID complement
fields.description: Bit-wise complement of UID; (UID XOR complement) = all ones if valid.

fields.name: Repetition
fields.description: 16 copies of {UID + complement} streamed; host iterates copies on retrieval-error detection.

otp_registers.name: Extended Parameter Page (signature 'EPPS')
otp_factory_fields: Section type 2 = Extended ECC Information block: number of bits ECC correctability, codeword size, bad blocks max per LUN, block endurance

otp_registers.name: Factory Defect Map (Section 3.3)
otp_factory_fields: Bad blocks marked at the manufacturer's facility before shipment.
First byte of spare area of the first or last page of each bad block is non-FFh.
Host shall scan all blocks during initial format and build the bad-block table.
Erase of factory-marked bad block shall be refused by the device (FAIL bit).

non_otp_device_state: Other device state — Status Register (volatile, per-LUN), Feature Parameter File (programmed by Set Features, volatile across power cycle by default but may be persistent for some features per vendor implementation), page register contents (volatile), array contents (persistent, modifiable via Program/Erase), Volume Address (programmed during enumeration each boot).
notes: From the host point of view, Parameter Page + Read ID + Unique ID + Factory Defect Map form the OTP-style fingerprint of an ONFI device. The Parameter Page CRC + redundancy + Extended Parameter Page provide retrieval-error robustness without host-side bookkeeping. The Unique ID + complement scheme is novel — it avoids requiring the host to track which UID copy was used, and self-validates via XOR-equals-all-ones.
